## Houston 0.6.16

### Houston on your phone

- **Finish setup and work from your phone**, with a message box and board controls that fit the screen and a keyboard that stays out of the way.

### Clearer waiting, fewer alarming errors

- **Send a message to a sleeping agent and see it right away**, with a calm waking up notice instead of a red error.

### Connections that just work

- **Connecting an app now opens its sign-in reliably**, even when your browser blocks pop-ups.
- **Signing in with a Claude subscription now works on Mac-hosted setups.**

### Fixes and polish

- **Amazon Bedrock now offers only the models your key can actually run.**
- **Running a routine now uses the connections of the person who pressed Run.**
- Additional reliability improvements under the hood.
